entries.title: Psalms 33:1
segments: ¶Exult, ye righteous, in Jehovah: praise is comely for the upright.

entries.title: Psalms 33:2
segments: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp; sing psalms unto him with the ten-stringed lute.

entries.title: Psalms 33:3
segments: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud sound.

entries.title: Psalms 33:4
segments: For the word of Jehovah is right, and all his work is in faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 33:5
segments: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the loving-kindness of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 33:6
segments: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:7
segments: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap; he layeth up the deeps in storehouses.

entries.title: Psalms 33:8
segments: Let all the earth fear Jehovah; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:9
segments: For *he* spoke, and it was [done]; *he* commanded, and it stood fast.

entries.title: Psalms 33:10
segments: Jehovah frustrateth the counsel of the nations; he maketh the thoughts of the peoples of none effect.

entries.title: Psalms 33:11
segments: The counsel of Jehovah standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.

entries.title: Psalms 33:12
segments: ¶Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, the people that he hath chosen for his inheritance!

entries.title: Psalms 33:13
segments: Jehovah looketh from the heavens; he beholdeth all the sons of men:

entries.title: Psalms 33:14
segments: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth upon all the inhabitants of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 33:15
segments: He who fashioneth the hearts of them all, who considereth all their works.

entries.title: Psalms 33:16
segments: The king is not saved by the multitude of [his] forces; a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:17
segments: The horse is a vain thing for safety; neither doth he deliver by his great power.

entries.title: Psalms 33:18
segments: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his loving-kindness,

entries.title: Psalms 33:19
segments: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

entries.title: Psalms 33:20
segments: Our soul waiteth for Jehovah: he is our help and our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 33:21
segments: For in him shall our heart rejoice, because we have confided in his holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 33:22
segments: Let thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, according as we have hoped in thee.
